meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务组建含执行、指挥、评审三类角色的智能体团队,按串行、并行或循环方式协作完成任务,并实时展示各角色的发言、辩论与决策过程,所有角色共享同一份上下文记忆。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发;也可以直接点名预设团队,例如「请用技术决策团队评估某方案」。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 你会看到主持人引导、各角色辩论到形成共识

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、工程实现三步输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析师、财务顾问等角色参与讨论

howto.what_en: Claude builds a team of agents in execution, management, and review roles, runs them in serial, parallel, or looping collaboration, shows each agent's speech and debate live, and shares one context memory across all agents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when managing an agent group for a scenario; you can name a preset team, e.g. "use the tech decision team to assess a plan".

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to assess a microservice plan
say_en.note: You'll see the host guide debate and reach a consensus

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for short-video AI
say_en.note: Outputs strategy, product architecture, then working code

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market and finance roles join the discussion
